TZA.note: Iris and facial verification is for registration and identification; no authentication service stated.
No enrolment count or share given.
Construction and procurement only; no statement of who operates or maintains the system.
No register keyed on the ID number mentioned.

facts.fact: The Deputy Minister of Home Affairs told the National Assembly that Phase II of the National ID System Expansion Project is being implemented, with a Dodoma headquarters, an ICT equipment maintenance centre and registration offices in 31 districts, following Phase I (data centre, disaster recovery centre, offices in 13 districts).

TZA.note: Iris and facial verification is described as an addition to be introduced, not as a current check.
